items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 52:1
items.html: The level of SAG that illuminates in Beriah, although it is the discernment of GAR, is nevertheless far indeed from the SAG that illuminates in Atzilut, and is considered only an illumination from the GAR, as above in answer 50. And it is called "GAR by means of a screen", because the screen of phase two that serves the level of SAG of Beriah is joined and included with the Parsa that concludes Atzilut, and it became a screen that separates and distinguishes all the illumination of Hochma from the Hassadim. Therefore they are discerned as a light of offshoot from the GAR of the SAG of Atzilut, and they are not the essence of the GAR. And for this reason they are called: GAR by means of a screen. (Item 209).
